description: Shared installer for distributing Python CLI tools as Scoop manifests via uv (isolated per-tool envs, shared cache + on-demand Python). Not a user tool; other Python manifests depend on it.
notes: Library manifest: carries the shared Install-PyTool.ps1 and a persisted uv cache. Python tool manifests 'depends' on this and call scripts\Install-PyTool.ps1 from pre_install.
